review_scope: Independent read-only re-computation from raw stage32 reproduction; no GPU execution, build or source edits.
conclusions: The retained 48.34% outlier did not recur in 48 calls (12 fresh processes, 36 repeats); first/repeats within a process are correlated, not 48 independent samples.
All hashes checked against current disk match; reported summary medians and process RSS reproduce from raw results; exact ordered outputs, all non-clock work and corresponding-phase capacities match.
Observed probe-versus-disabled timing deltas include ordinary between-process variability; they are a bounded sensitivity check, not the isolated cost of the snapshot API.
All 16 diagnostic calls have available nonnegative process and host counters; major faults are zero. This describes the new runs, not the original uninstrumented anomalous call.

The original cause remains uncertain. Non-reproduction and unchanged work are consistent with a transient runtime/measurement disturbance but do not rule out an intermittent program performance issue.
limits: Host busy/idle ticks cover the whole machine; they are not the matching process CPU utilization or GPU utilization.
Process user+system time aggregates process threads and is not interchangeable with wall time or a whole-machine CPU fraction.
GPU wait includes GPU execution; wait-minus-device is not measured transfer time and cannot diagnose transmission bandwidth.

Resource wall minus algorithm wall is only boundary padding; capture starts its clock before counters and final capture timestamps before counter reads, so this difference is not the total probe cost.
There is no thermal/frequency or original-call counter timeline, so no proved thermal, OS scheduling, paging, or driver root cause.
Shared synthetic image across all calls does not provide 48 independent accuracy scenes.

interpretation: Combined existing u8 input and shared storage removes one first-call float conversion temporary and one duplicated resident float image; exact shared capacity includes separate page rounding for source and template.
The fast pipeline peak RSS falls by 258.45MiB and full-resolution pipeline by 257.78MiB in this sample; do not add overlapped host/gpu/shared fields or call this a new algorithm.
Fast repeat is approximately 0.21% faster and full-resolution repeat approximately 0.56% slower; initialization/memory reduction is supported, broad search-kernel acceleration is not.
All 32 calls preserve ordered output and non-clock search work; both settings reuse the same 512 synthetic objects, not 1024 independent scenes.

report_review.scope: Read first section and capacity design before second section numeric results were inserted.
report_review.numeric_findings: Retained outlier attribution, reproduction table, exact/work statements and same-block repeat-median comparisons agree with raw data.
minor_wording_findings: Use two resource snapshots rather than two syscalls: each snapshot may perform getrusage, host_statistics, mach_host_self and mach_port_deallocate.
The diagnostic repeat wall-minus-total range is0.004416–0.010542ms; if rounding to three decimals, use0.004–0.011ms rather than0.004–0.010ms.
report_review.causal_findings: Report correctly preserves original failure and unknown root cause, and distinguishes full-machine host ticks, process CPU time, wait/device overlap and correlated repeats.
